description: NPS-2014 USB non-deterministic corpus. Transcend JetFlash V10 1GB (D33193). Four E01 images (two Linux dc3dd, two Windows FTK Imager) of the same unchanged USB device. All four images have different hashes due to USB firmware returning SCSI READ(10) command content in non-written flash sectors. Hardware non-determinism — not anti-forensics.

artifacts.description: Cross-acquisition sector diff at sector 100005: linux-first Tag=94060000, linux-second Tag=007f0000. Tag field (bulk_cb_wrap bytes 4-7) varies per SCSI READ command on Linux — OS assigns new tag per command. Same LBA and TransferLength in both. Firmware echoes the SCSI command block back as sector data. Mechanism: bulk_cb_wrap.Tag is unique per command; sector data = command block at read time.
